reference_traces.rationale: The reviewer identified the functional connection of Piezo2 to silent-nociceptor mechanotransduction as the distinctive contribution. The final paper frames nociceptor-specific depletion against prior pan-sensory deletion in P:S-421f331cd8a3b646a8e2.

The reviewer limited translational interpretation because the intra-articular NGF exposure does not reproduce human disease exposure. The final limitations text confirms that injected NGF exceeds human osteoarthritic-joint levels in P:S-4ba5185188601bbc5829.

The reviewer specifically valued the conditional knockout, local chemogenetic silencing, and human DRG expression work. These elements are present in P:S-2da2b1f627200a1ee40d and P:S-49c11f0f1a0f377c7db6.

The reviewer regarded the added weight-bearing measurement as addressing the functional concern. The final paper reports concurrent weight-bearing and knee-hyperalgesia results after DMM in P:S-2138bd0283d7bc6e8cab.

The reviewer noted that Fig. 2 used heterozygous rather than complete knockout animals, limiting interpretation of partial changes. The final imaging result remains reported in heterozygous mice in P:S-ea6a757a4341813999b7.

The reviewer asked whether noxious knee-twist responses could be assessed in Piezo2 knockout animals. The final discussion states that high-intensity mechanical detection without inflammation involves an unidentified channel or receptor in P:S-fa6afa5717f7859ed1a5.
The request for gait analysis was addressed with a weight-bearing measure, which the reviewer subsequently stated addressed the question; P:S-2138bd0283d7bc6e8cab documents that final measure.

The terminology concern about noxious versus non-noxious mechanical stimuli was resolved by reframing the final figure around forces and intracellular calcium responses; P:S-9cbad90e70e6c6a3584a gives the final figure title.
The concern that paw withdrawal alone was not joint-specific was addressed by concurrent DMM weight-bearing and knee-hyperalgesia assessments in the final paper, P:S-2138bd0283d7bc6e8cab.
The CNO drug-specific-effect concern was addressed with a receptor-specific CFA control experiment, retained in the final paper at P:S-2da2b1f627200a1ee40d.
The remaining Fig. 2 visualization request was addressed by increasing heatmap font size and adding wild-type stimulus labels; the final figure is represented by P:S-9cbad90e70e6c6a3584a.

limiting_points.suggested_action: Interpret the NGF-injection findings as mechanistic evidence rather than a direct recreation of human osteoarthritis exposure.
limiting_points.text: The NGF-injection model uses concentrations higher than those reported in human osteoarthritic joints, limiting the translational scope of the therapeutic interpretation.

supporting_points.text: The specific contribution is functional evidence that nociceptor-expressed Piezo2 participates in joint mechanosensation and mechanical sensitization, extending prior work based on broad sensory-neuron deletion and mechanical allodynia.

questions.suggested_action: Determine whether Piezo2 deletion alters neuronal and behavioral responses to noxious knee-twist or high-intensity mechanical stimuli in adequately powered cohorts.
questions.text: Does Piezo2 remain necessary for responses to noxious knee-twist or high-intensity mechanical stimuli in the absence of inflammation, and which alternative channel or receptor mediates residual responses?

strengths.text: The conditional knockout, local chemogenetic silencing, and mouse-to-human DRG expression analyses provide converging evidence linking Piezo2-positive nociceptors to joint-pain mechanisms.
The DMM experiment pairs weight-bearing asymmetry with knee hyperalgesia over time, adding a functional joint-pain-related outcome to the behavioral evidence.

summary.text: The study examines nociceptor-specific Piezo2 in experimental joint pain using conditional deletion, calcium imaging, DMM and inflammatory models, acute local neuronal silencing, and mouse and human DRG expression analyses. The central contribution is a functional link between Piezo2-positive nociceptors and mechanical sensitization, supported by added weight-bearing evidence, while the NGF exposure model and heterozygous imaging design limit the breadth of translational and mechanistic inference.

weaknesses.suggested_action: Add adequately powered homozygous conditional-knockout imaging comparisons across the tested force range.
weaknesses.text: The calcium-imaging experiment relies on heterozygous Piezo2 conditional-knockout mice, so partial depletion complicates interpretation of the magnitude and specificity of the imaging effects relative to the homozygous knockout behavioral experiments.

revision_ledger.residual_summary: Weight-bearing asymmetry was added in place of gait analysis and the reviewer stated that it addressed the concern.
The final figure description removes the disputed noxious/non-noxious framing.
Joint-specific weight-bearing and knee-hyperalgesia outcomes were added for DMM mice.
A CFA receptor-specific CNO control was incorporated into the final study.
The remaining heatmap-labeling and readability issue was addressed in the final Figure 2.
